status: declared before any result; owner (16 Nov): 'continue' (next item: borders between neighbouring states, where natural borders may matter)
question: Where states meet, does the model give each piece of land to the right state, and do drainage-basin cantons (borders on watershed divides) do it better?
target: Cliopatria v0.2.1 polygons alive in the pool year, rasterised per polity Name (first polygon wins where they overlap; overlap share reported)
sources: each pool's towns, labelled with the Cliopatria polity containing them; towns in no polity are dropped
held: control v2.1 held land as in plan_A3 preparation (staffed towns and kept roads within 2 year-round days)

rules.O0_map: owner = the polity whose staffed towns reach the cell in the fewest year-round days (the map's control v2 rule)
rules.C7, C8: O0 owner, then each HydroBASINS level-7 (or 8) basin takes the majority owner of its held cells
rules.E0_null: owner = polity of the nearest town in straight-line distance (reported only)

scores.OA: owner agreement: share of cells held by the model and inside a real polity that has at least one source, where the model owner equals the real polity
scores.border_recall: share of real internal border cells (between two polities with sources, inside held land) within 2 cells of a model internal border
scores.reported_only: divide and river enrichment of real and model internal borders

development.pools: D1 Bosker cities 1200, Rome window with Itiner-e roads; D2 Bosker 1500 (same); D3 CHGIS seats 1200, Han window (all seen in earlier outer-edge tests)
development.choice: the canton level (7 or 8) with the higher mean OA over the dev pools

blind.B1: Bosker cities 1400, Rome window with Itiner-e roads
blind.B2: Bosker cities 1600, Rome window with Itiner-e roads
blind.B3: CHGIS V6 seats 1140 (Southern Song, Jin, Western Xia), Han window
blind.note: years never used in any control test; prepared without scoring, scored once

blind_gates.G1: chosen canton OA >= O0 OA + 0.01 in at least two of three blind pools
blind_gates.G2: chosen canton OA >= O0 OA - 0.01 in every blind pool
blind_gates.adopt: G1 and G2: watershed cantons are offered for the map's internal borders (needs map basins from height map v2.1). Otherwise O0 stays; the OA scores stand as the first Earth test of the map's owner rule.
